description: The tracked bash ADR-040 §5 rule 2 admits besides forwarders (rule 1's shape: at most 12 lines of code, no loop, no case). `stays` is the closed pre-Python list, each file with its reason; adding to it is a finding. `ports` names the files not yet ported, each with its batch; it only shrinks, and a port removes its entry in the same pull request.

stays.runtime/provisioning/platform/debian.sh: a platform profile, sourced where only the host's shell exists (before python_pin.py install has made fabric-python, or where it cannot be)
stays.runtime/provisioning/platform/fedora.sh: a platform profile, sourced where only the host's shell exists (before python_pin.py install has made fabric-python, or where it cannot be)
stays.runtime/provisioning/platform/detect.sh: picks the platform profile, sourced where only the host's shell exists (before python_pin.py install has made fabric-python, or where it cannot be)
stays.runtime/provisioning/platform/packages.s: installs the host contract the pin needs; CI's smoke job runs it (before python_pin.py install has made fabric-python, or where it cannot be)
stays.runtime/provisioning/platform/qubes/ssh-: runs in a Qubes TemplateVM, which has no pinned interpreter
runs at a Qubes AppVM's boot, before an interpreter exists
runs at a Qubes AppVM's boot, before an interpreter exists
stays.runtime/provisioning/platform/qubes/agen: a Qubes rc script, run at boot before an interpreter exists
stays.runtime/provisioning/moveto/enter-ssh: an sshd forced command for an account before its interpreter
stays.runtime/provisioning/moveto/completion.b: bash completion, which only bash reads

ports.tools/fabric/control/completion.bash: fabric-ctl's bash completion, which only bash reads: not on ADR-040's closed list; stays or goes by an ADR-040 amendment (j368)
